Every Perplexity Project is a Git repo. We built a Git forge for agents, without the GitHub bloat, since no human has to approve anything.

Each agent gets its own short-lived sandbox and commits to a shared repo on S3. Fewer than 2% of submissions collide.

We’re open-sourcing pplx-embed-v2-late, multi-vector embeddings for text and images, 9B and 0.6B, in one shared embedding space. You can use these to index multimodal data with 9B, and query on device with 0.6B. This also enables you to search over PDF pages with no OCR. And https://t.co/O1Ga7lAr96

Engineering Design as a service https://t.co/JaYrc7B2Zh

Perplexity Decider is the best decision model https://t.co/k0k2rcDazb

We got Computer playing StarCraft against Computer, in real time. No pausing. The game keeps running while each agent thinks.

Blue 2 – Red 5

Final match. Blue builds up safely, reaches 41 Dragoons, and moves out. Red is waiting with High Templar and hits the army with Psionic https://t.co/fU1hbYiTSW
A spatial canvas for heavy duty multi-tasking. https://t.co/b40goeX2Lj
You can build custom vertical AI apps inside Computer, eg: guess spatial location of an image with 3D and satellite view. https://t.co/rLzam2L4sH

Pokémon FireRed’s Elite Four + Champion, cleared in one shot - with decision-making powered by Perplexity’s Decisions API.

The actual run stats:

592 ms median API response 
987 ms p95 - 96.4% of responses under one second 
$0.028 estimated inference cost, 137 live API calls https://t.co/xM40AY34dv

Try “Visualize….” in Computer and ask for whatever you want to learn visually. You will now get an inline viz with rich educative and interactive widgets and animations! Have fun! Best experienced on Standard or High effort. https://t.co/f7Xbh3aG2U

Our goal is to vertically integrate our agentic infrastructure: own our sandboxes, and optimize the sandbox for the best silicon. Vera is far better than x86. Look forward to sharing more soon as we begin to rollout deployment of Perplexity Computer on Vera. https://t.co/3xzKZlpOJx

Your creativity is the limit in terms of what you can have Computer do for you. This is the kind of project that you can let an agent run for hours to come back with something great. https://t.co/OAG3HxZK8v

a few open source contributions from perplexity recently:

•pplx-decider-v1-27b: SoTA multimodal decision model. 85.7% average across 11 benchmarks, ahead of Jev.
•pplx-embed-v2-context-9b-preview: SoTA contextual embeddings, best on ConTEB and turbopuffer context-bench.
We would love to hear how we can improve our developer platform! https://t.co/adHEmJvjS0

We’re open sourcing a state of the art multimodal Decision Model, pplx-decider-27b, and are offering it in a new Decisions API at 4 cents per million input tokens and free output tokens. We intend to bring down the price even further over the coming days. Enjoy! https://t.co/0pX4zAMdFA
We’re rolling out inline charts, diagrams, visualizations in Computer. Including contextual financial charts from @tradingview https://t.co/O2c2t1L1sz
Seedance inside Computer is quite incredible for marketing and brand teams! https://t.co/tVvW0atXw5
